fields.description_1: GS Privéchauffeur offers private chauffeur, airport transport, BOB rides, vehicle transport and valet services. The website needed to make those different travel situations understandable quickly while keeping comfort, reliability and booking central.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around the booking journey and the main service types. Visitors can move from choosing a chauffeur service into trip details, vehicle choice and reservation, while service information, pricing context and trust signals stay close to the decision.

fields.description_1: Businesssuites rents flexible workspaces across multiple locations, including private offices, coworking and meeting rooms with different sizes, facilities and rental terms. The website needed to make those differences easy to compare before a visitor books or enquires.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress site around locations and workspace types, with practical details such as size, pricing and facilities kept close to each option. Clear booking and enquiry routes help visitors move from comparing spaces to arranging a suitable workplace without unnecessary steps.

fields.description_1: Ingenieursbureau Traject provides civil-engineering services including design, contracts, SSK cost estimates, project supervision, citizen participation and cable-and-pipe coordination. The website needed to explain that broad technical offer while using real projects to show how the expertise is applied.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress content around the main civil-engineering disciplines and connected them with project examples and advice routes. Visitors can move from a specific technical need into the relevant service, see supporting project evidence and then contact the team with enough context to discuss the assignment.

fields.description_1: Monitor Politieke Ontwikkeling is a content-heavy nonprofit platform built around policy positions, research, reports, activities and press updates. The website needed to keep long-form information and downloadable publications accessible without making the organisation’s broader mission difficult to understand.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around research, reports, activities and organisational information, with clear routes to publications, support and contact. The responsive hierarchy keeps long-form political and policy content readable while making the most important documents and next steps easier to find.

fields.description_1: Kroess & Visser brings bookkeeping, financial administration, payroll, tax support and business advice together in one finance-focused website. The challenge was to separate those services clearly while giving entrepreneurs enough trust and context before they start an advice conversation.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress content into distinct finance and advisory routes, supported by practical explanations and trust content. Visitors can identify the service that fits their situation and move toward contact without having to interpret a broad list of accounting terms first.

fields.description_1: Superfruitmand is a WooCommerce webshop for fruit boxes, fruit baskets and gifts. The website needed to keep product discovery and ordering simple while still showing category choice, pricing, product details and options such as adding a personal card.
fields.description_2: I structured the webshop around clear product categories and direct product pages with visible price and order controls. Business information, account access and cart actions stay available throughout the journey, so visitors can move from browsing fruit products to checkout without losing context.

fields.description_1: Progress serves both professionals looking for vacancies and employers looking for staff across sectors such as technology, telecom, energy, finance, customer service and government. The website needed to separate those two journeys while still presenting one clear recruitment brand.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around vacancy discovery for candidates and staffing services for employers. Sector expertise, client proof and reviews support both routes, while applications and employer enquiries remain separate enough that each audience can move directly toward its own next step.

fields.description_1: PRO Metaal presents a metal-recycling business built around materials, processing and circular reuse. The website needed to explain services for metals such as aluminium, copper, old iron and electronics while keeping sustainability and the practical business enquiry visible.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress content around recyclable material types, the recycling proposition and direct contact actions. Clear service routes and sustainability context make the industrial offer easier to understand, while businesses can quickly move from identifying a material stream to discussing collection or processing.
